Pillar 03 · I³ — Induction · Interference · Intelligence

The interface every MTDI pillar is seen through, extracted from Inductra Vaion's front end. MTDI Studio generates its pages from a project manifest (mtdi/studio/views.py). I³ can also run on its own from a hand-written content pack:

from mtdi.pillars.i3 import create_app, load
create_app(load("mtdi/pillars/i3/examples/placeholder.json")).run(port=8050)
PieceOrigin in Inductra
Startup intro (WebGL shader, split title, overview card)theme.startup_intro, browser.bootStartupIntro
Glass header, nav, status pillswebapp layout, theme header CSS
Page shaderbrowser.bootPageShader
Scroll-locked openings: field (magnetosphere), flow (signal path, data-driven)ui.fieldPainter, ui.mtdiFlowPainter
Module orbit round the globe, pillar orbit opening to full screenbrowser.armHomeOrbit, bootHomeGlobe, armMtdiOrbit
NVTRA dock with wire-sphere orb#iv-orb island, browser.bootMascot

Page types: home, framework, document, module, settings. Block kinds: section, text, cards, metrics, slot, spark, live, actions, list, quote. [[term]] in any text renders a highlighted technical term.

Hooks passed to create_app:

  • state_provider() → {bind_key: value | {"value", "state"} | [numbers]}, polled by the browser; elements with "bind" follow their key, spark blocks draw lists.
  • ask_handler(question, path) → the NVTRA dock's answer.
  • action_handler(action, args) → message for actions blocks (raise ValueError to refuse).

static.py renders the same components to plain HTML (the website is built this way), and assets/i3.js has no Dash dependency: it runs on data-i3-* attributes and window.I3_CONFIG, so the same assets can back a static or React build later. Not carried over from Inductra: hand vision, the Spline robot, voice.
